title: How a Man of God Speaks Up When the Group Chat Turns Crude
caption:
Silence in a crude group chat is still a vote.

You don't need a sermon. One calm line, said once, gives the quiet guy next to you permission to follow.

What's the one line you could use next time?

#faith #godlymen #christianman #integrity #proverbs #brotherhood
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
